title: Merger proposals, management discretion and stockholder wealth

context.industry_setting: cross-industry (NYSE-listed firms; merger proposals across sectors)

analyses.label: Table 1 - PE/CPE for 151 targets and 126 bidders, 40 days around first public announcement of the merger proposal
analyses.sample: 151 target firms and 126 bidder firms; NYSE merger proposals over the seven years ended December 31, 1977

key_ivs.name: merger proposal announcement (event)
key_ivs.measure: day 0 = date the proposal is first publicly announced (first mentioned in the Wall Street Journal)

key_ivs.name: firm role
key_ivs.measure: firms classified as either bidders or targets

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 2 - PE/CPE for 151 target firms split into 80 cancelled and 71 completed proposals, around first announcement
analyses.sample: 151 target firms: 80 cancelled and 71 completed merger proposals

key_ivs.name: proposal outcome
key_ivs.measure: proposals classified as later completed (71) versus later cancelled (80)

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 3 - PE/CPE for 126 bidder firms split into 66 cancelled and 60 completed proposals, around first announcement
analyses.sample: 126 bidder firms: 66 cancelled and 60 completed merger proposals

key_ivs.name: proposal outcome
key_ivs.measure: bidder firms in 66 cancelled versus 60 completed merger proposals

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 4 - PE/CPE for 71 target and 60 bidder firms in completed mergers, 40 days around announcement of stockholder approval
analyses.sample: 71 target firms and 60 bidder firms in completed merger proposals

key_ivs.name: announcement of merger approval (outcome event)
key_ivs.measure: day 0 = date of announcement of approval of the merger by target stockholders

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 5 - PE/CPE for 80 target and 66 bidder firms around announcement of termination of merger proposals
analyses.sample: 80 target firms and 66 bidder firms in cancelled merger proposals

key_ivs.name: announcement of termination (outcome event)
key_ivs.measure: day 0 = date of publication of the termination of merger negotiations in the Wall Street Journal

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 6 - PE/CPE around termination for (A) proposals terminated by target management (N=26) vs (B) non-target management (N=54)
analyses.sample: 80 cancelled proposals split into 26 target-management terminations and 54 non-target terminations

key_ivs.name: terminating party (management discretion)
key_ivs.measure: cancelled proposals classified as terminated by target management (veto, N=26) versus non-target/bidder management (N=54)

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 7 - PE/CPE for 71 target firms in completed mergers, 250 days before (A) stockholder approval date vs (B) proposal announcement date (event-date-selection test)

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)

analyses.label: Table 8 - summary of net cumulative abnormal returns over the full duration of the merger proposals
analyses.sample: target and bidder firms across completed and cancelled merger proposals

dv.name: net cumulative abnormal return to stockholders

key_ivs.name: firm role and proposal outcome
key_ivs.measure: target vs bidder firms in completed vs cancelled proposals over the duration of the proposal

controls.name: return on a value-weighted market portfolio (market-model expected return)
